name: Pohara
headline: Holiday homes in Pohara
intro: Pohara is Golden Bay’s easy beach base — a long sandy stretch, a cafe strip within walking distance of many baches, and the jump-off for Abel Tasman day trips. Most of our catalogue sits here because guests keep asking for that mix of swim-after-breakfast mornings and a proper kitchen for the evening barbecue.
body:
Families book Pohara for short beach walks with littlies, couples for ocean-view decks, and groups for homes that sleep the whole crew without splitting across town. Guests often mention dog-friendly stays, self check-in after a late ferry or drive over Takaka Hill, and hotel-quality linen so nobody is hunting for towels on day one.

If you want live dates, start on a Pohara home page or the main catalogue filter — availability stays in Guesty, while these pages help you compare settings, sleeps, and neighbourhood feel before you book direct.
highlights: Largest cluster of our Golden Bay holiday homes
Beach, bush-backed, and ocean-view options in one town
Walkable cafes and a gentle bay for swimming
Strong base for Abel Tasman and Tata Beach day trips
Book direct for local 0800 support and price-match

faqs.q: Are there pet-friendly holiday homes in Pohara?
faqs.a: Yes — several Pohara homes welcome pets. Use the Pets filter on our homes catalogue, then confirm house rules on the listing before you book.

faqs.q: How far are Pohara holiday homes from the beach?
faqs.a: Many are a short walk or a couple of minutes’ drive from Pohara Beach. Listings tagged with walk times spell out the stroll; others sit slightly back with bush or hill outlooks.

faqs.q: Is Pohara a good base for Abel Tasman National Park?
faqs.a: It is one of the easiest Golden Bay bases — you can reach trailheads, water taxis, and Tata / Ligar Bay launches without a long daily commute.

faqs.q: Why book a Pohara holiday home direct with you?
faqs.a: You get hotel-quality linen, local guest support on 0800 150 810, and our price-match promise against the same dates on major OTAs.

name: Collingwood
headline: Holiday homes in Collingwood
intro: Collingwood is the western Golden Bay village — estuary light, a compact main street, and the gateway toward Farewell Spit and the northern beaches. Stays here suit guests who want township cafes close by and quieter evenings than the Pohara strip.
body:
Guests looking for “holiday home near Collingwood shops”, waterfront outlooks, or a base for Spit tours land here. Our Collingwood homes lean coastal and walkable: ocean views across the beach, character cottages, and space for families who still want a village feel.

Pair a Collingwood stay with Milnthorpe tracks, Kaihoka Lakes, and sunset walks along the inlet — then book direct so local support can help with linen, access, and last-minute questions.
highlights: Village base for Farewell Spit and northern Golden Bay
Beach-road and waterfront-leaning holiday homes
Cafes and essentials within an easy stroll for many stays
Quieter evenings than the main Pohara strip
Direct booking with local hosts Michael & Katja

faqs.q: What is Collingwood like for a family holiday?
faqs.a: It is compact and calm — beach and estuary walks, a short main street, and day trips to Farewell Spit. Choose a home by sleeps and bedrooms so everyone has room after Spit tours.

faqs.q: Do Collingwood holiday homes have ocean views?
faqs.a: Some do — look for ocean-view tags on the catalogue or open each listing. Beach Road stays often look straight across the shore.

faqs.q: How far is Collingwood from Takaka?
faqs.a: About a 25–30 minute drive west along the coastal highway, depending on traffic and stops.

faqs.q: Can I book a Collingwood home for a longer winter stay?
faqs.a: Many owners welcome longer bookings outside peak summer. Message us with dates — we will confirm minimum stays and winter rates in Guesty.

name: Tata Beach
headline: Holiday homes in Tata Beach
intro: Tata Beach is the sheltered cove east of Pohara — clear water, kayak launches, and homes tucked into bush or perched for ocean views. Guests who type “quiet beach holiday home Golden Bay” often mean Tata.
body:
Expect regenerating bush tracks to the sand, lofted living spaces with bay outlooks, and a slower rhythm than the main Pohara shops. It is a favourite for couples and small groups who want morning swims and afternoon shade under the trees.

Kayak hire sits on the beach in season; Abel Tasman water access is close. Book direct for linen, local tips, and clear arrival instructions.
highlights: Sheltered bay for swimming and kayaking
Bush-backed and ocean-view holiday homes
Quieter than central Pohara
Close to Ligar Bay and Abel Tasman launches
Hotel-quality linen and local support included

faqs.q: Is Tata Beach good for kayaking?
faqs.a: Yes — calm water and local kayak hire make it one of Golden Bay’s easiest paddle spots in settled weather. Always check conditions and your own experience level.

faqs.q: Are Tata Beach homes suitable for couples?
faqs.a: Several are ideal for two — look at guest counts and bedroom layouts. Larger homes also sleep families who want the quieter bay.

faqs.q: How close is Tata Beach to Pohara?
faqs.a: Only a few minutes’ drive east along Abel Tasman Drive — easy to pop into Pohara for groceries or dinner.

faqs.q: Do any Tata Beach stays feel private or bushy?
faqs.a: Yes — some sit in regenerating bush or on headland edges. Filter by Bush setting or read each listing’s neighbourhood notes.

name: Patons Rock
headline: Holiday homes in Patons Rock
intro: Patons Rock is a small coastal settlement west of Takaka — open beach, modern baches across from the sand, and space to breathe. Guests come for uncomplicated beach days without village bustle.
body:
Search phrases we hear: “beach house steps from the sand”, “modern Patons Rock holiday home”, and “quiet Golden Bay stay with kayaks”. Homes here favour indoor–outdoor flow, decks for the afternoon nor’wester, and easy parking for boats or bikes.

Hack Farm horse treks and west-bay beaches are nearby. Book direct so we can help with access codes, linen timing, and local weather calls.
highlights: Beach-facing holiday homes with easy sand access
Modern open-plan stays popular with families
Quieter coastal pocket west of Takaka
Handy for horse treks and west-bay day trips
Direct booking with price-match promise

faqs.q: How far is Patons Rock from Takaka?
faqs.a: Roughly 10–15 minutes by car, depending on where you are staying along the settlement.

faqs.q: Are Patons Rock beaches safe for kids?
faqs.a: The beach is open and tidal — great for sand play in settled weather. Always supervise children and respect rips and changing tides.

faqs.q: Do Patons Rock homes allow pets?
faqs.a: It depends on the listing. Use the Pets filter on our catalogue and read each home’s house rules.

faqs.q: What is there to do near Patons Rock?
faqs.a: Beach walks, nearby horse treks, and easy drives to Takaka, Pupu Springs, or further west toward Collingwood.

name: Ligar Bay
headline: Holiday homes in Ligar Bay
intro: Ligar Bay sits between Pohara and Tata — a curved sandy bay, afternoon light on the water, and a handful of distinctive stays including elevated retreats with spa decks.
body:
Guests choose Ligar for romantic coastal escapes, spa evenings after beach days, and a base that still reaches Tata kayaks or Pohara dinners in minutes. It is smaller inventory, so book early for peak summer.

If you want something memorable rather than a standard bach, Ligar is where character homes and bay views tend to cluster in our list.
highlights: Small, scenic bay between Pohara and Tata
Character stays including spa and elevated outlooks
Easy hop to kayaks, cafes, and Abel Tasman
Popular for couples and small groups
Book direct for local arrival support

faqs.q: Is Ligar Bay quieter than Pohara?
faqs.a: Generally yes — fewer shops on the doorstep and a more residential bay feel, with Pohara only a short drive away when you want cafes.

faqs.q: Do any Ligar Bay homes have a spa?
faqs.a: Yes — check the Spa filter or listing details. Spas are hand-tagged when the property clearly offers one.

faqs.q: Can we walk to Tata Beach from Ligar Bay?
faqs.a: In good conditions it is a pleasant coastal wander for confident walkers, but most guests drive the short hop — ask us for current track tips.

faqs.q: How many Ligar Bay holiday homes do you manage?
faqs.a: A small curated set — browse this page for the current list and live dates in each booking panel.

name: Parapara
headline: Holiday homes in Parapara
intro: Parapara sits on the coastal road between Takaka and Collingwood — bush valleys behind, inlet and beach moments in front. Stays here suit guests who want nature on the doorstep without giving up a Golden Bay beach day.
body:
Think bush tracks outside the gate, modern interiors with view decks, and a short drive to either township when you need supplies. Guests describe Parapara as the “best of both” — regenerating bushland plus beach access nearby.

Ideal if you are searching for a peaceful Golden Bay retreat that still connects Collingwood Spit trips and Pohara swimming.
highlights: Bush-meets-coast setting on the Collingwood highway
Scenic tracks and quieter nights
Driveable to Takaka, Collingwood, and west beaches
View-led holiday homes with thoughtful interiors
Local linen and 0800 guest support

faqs.q: Is Parapara more bush or beach?
faqs.a: Both — many homes sit among bush with beach or inlet access a short drive (sometimes a walk) away. Read each listing’s setting tags.

faqs.q: How long to drive from Parapara to Collingwood?
faqs.a: Usually around 10–15 minutes west, depending on your exact driveway and stops.

faqs.q: Are Parapara homes good for couples?
faqs.a: Yes — intimate two-bedroom retreats are common here, alongside larger options when available.

faqs.q: Will we need a car?
faqs.a: Strongly recommended. Parapara is a settlement, not a full service town — a car unlocks beaches, shops, and day trips.

name: Onekaka
headline: Holiday homes in Onekaka
intro: Onekakā is a peaceful stretch of the Takaka–Collingwood highway — river flats, birdsong, and room between neighbours. It is for guests who want a Golden Bay base without living on the main beach strip.
body:
Our Onekaka stays work well for families and groups who will day-trip to beaches, Pupu Springs, and Collingwood, then come home to a spacious villa with a fireplace and quiet evenings. Search intent here is less “steps from sand” and more “relaxed rural-coastal Golden Bay home”.

Book direct for clear directions, linen, and tips on the best nearby swimming holes and cafes.
highlights: Quiet highway-side Golden Bay setting
Spacious homes suited to families and groups
Easy drive to beaches, springs, and Collingwood
Fireplace-friendly evenings outside peak summer
Hands-on local property management

faqs.q: Is Onekaka on the beach?
faqs.a: Not usually doorstep sand — expect a short drive to coastal beaches while enjoying a quieter inland-coastal pocket.

faqs.q: What size groups suit Onekaka homes?
faqs.a: Larger villas can sleep bigger families or friends’ groups. Check guest and bedroom counts on each listing.

faqs.q: How far is Onekaka from Takaka?
faqs.a: Around 15–20 minutes west toward Collingwood on the main highway.

faqs.q: Do you manage many homes in Onekaka?
faqs.a: A select few — this page always shows the current Onekaka homes in our Golden Bay collection.

name: East Takaka
headline: Holiday homes in East Takaka
intro: East Takaka (East Tākaka) sits inland from the main beach towns — farmland outlooks, big-sky evenings, and a true countryside Golden Bay pace minutes from Takaka township.
body:
Guests who want “farm stay energy” with holiday-home comfort land here: space for kids to run, starry nights, and a short drive into Takaka for supplies, Aroha Spa, or the road over to Pohara beaches.

It is a different flavour of Golden Bay — less salt on the breeze, more paddock and hills — and a smart pick when beach-strip homes are fully booked.
highlights: Rural Golden Bay setting near Takaka
Farm and countryside outlooks
Quick drive to township services and cafes
Still close enough for beach day trips
Direct book with local hosts

faqs.q: How far is East Takaka from Pohara Beach?
faqs.a: Typically 15–25 minutes by car depending on exact addresses and traffic over the local roads.

faqs.q: Is East Takaka a good option if beach homes are full?
faqs.a: Yes — you keep a Golden Bay base with space and quiet, then day-trip to Pohara, Tata, or Collingwood.

faqs.q: Will we need a car in East Takaka?
faqs.a: Yes. There is no beach-strip walkability here; a car is essential for beaches, shops, and activities.

faqs.q: Are East Takaka stays suitable for kids?
faqs.a: Often ideal — more outdoor space and a quieter night. Always check each home’s fencing, hazards, and sleeps.
